messages:
alex: Quick design review — new credential create modal. Trying to reduce confusion around permission dropdown, rotate toggle, and the success empty state illustration. Sketch: https://intranet.redwood/sketches/cred-create-2.png
maria: Love the direction. Two quick calls: 1) permission label feels ambiguous — 'Access level' vs 'Role'. I vote for 'Role' (Developer / Read-only / Admin). 2) Move the 'Allow rotation' toggle below the secret reveal so it groups with lifecycle controls.
sam: +1 on Role. Also can we avoid the word 'secret' in the UI? Suggest 'key' or 'token' for end-user clarity.
jordan: Minor copy suggestion for the CTA: "Create key & copy" is long. What about "Create and copy" (primary) + "Create only" (secondary) — keeps words shorter for narrow screens.
lisa: A11y nit: modal should be role="dialog" with aria-labelledby and aria-describedby. Eg: <div role="dialog" aria-labelledby="modal-title" aria-describedby="modal-desc">. Also ensure focus trap and initial focus on the name input.
design-bot: Accessibility scan: contrast on the 'Create and copy' primary is 3.8:1 on focused state — fails AA for 14pt. Recommend adjusting to 4.5:1 or increasing size.
alex: Good calls. For the empty success state (after creation + copy), current illustration is big and pushes footer off-screen on small viewports. Ideas: swap to compact illustration + inline success copy "Key created — copied to clipboard" and an undo CTA.
maria: Undo CTA should be subtle — text button "Revoke" with aria-label="Revoke created key". Also include timestamp in the toast "Copied 1s ago" for clarity.
sam: What about permissions granularity? Product asked for 'scoped tokens' later — add microcopy: "This key can only call inference endpoints" and a link to docs.
jordan: UX concern: if user doesn't copy the key and closes modal, we should show a clear next-step: persistent banner or the credentials list with a 'Copy secret' action. Don't hide it behind a three-dot menu.
lisa: Screenreader flow check: after creation and closing modal, focus should go to the new key row with aria-live polite region announcing "New key created: <name>".
alex: I'll update the mockups and the copy deck. Action items: (1) change 'Access level' -> 'Role' (maria), (2) move rotation toggle (maria), (3) CTA copy variations for narrow screens (jordan), (4) a11y attrs + focus (lisa), (5) adjust contrast (design-bot), (6) add scoped token microcopy (sam), (7) persistent CTA if not copied (jordan). I'll ping for another quick sync tomorrow 11am. :thumbsup:
